tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// las kyi gshin rje lha bcu bdun pa'i phrin las bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ ya ma bcu bdun par brten pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhi drag rnams sgrub pa'i dus dang*/ skabs gzhan du'ang*/ dus gtor la sogs pa phrin las sgrub pa'i skabs la sogs par/ las gshin gyi phrin las mdor bsdus bya ba ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma sha khrag gis sbags pa dang*/ sman rak+ta dang*/ sha khrag las grub pa'i mchod pa tshogs par bshams| bris sku bkram/ rang nyid stan bde bar kha lhor phyogs pas/ yang zlog gi ngag 'don ltar bdag bskyed sngon du btang*/ bsnyen pa ci 'grub byas rjes/ mdun bskyed ni/ 'khrul 'khor yod na de la dmigs/ drug cu pa yin na lcags mkhar gyi nang dang gzhan du na/ mdun du dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/ lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu bdun gsal ba'i/ lcags mkhar dbus ma'i nang du mi ro dang rta ro mang po bsnol ba'i steng du/ ya las 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje bye ba dgu khri rdo sol ltar gnag pa/ g.yas mi mgos mtshan pa'i be con dang*/ g.yon dus kyi zhags pa nag po thogs pa/ mi dang glang po che'i ko rlon 'chang zhing stag sham can/ gcer bu sbrul dang thod pas brgyan cing me lce dang glog gi phreng bas spras pa/ yum gtum mo dug hrul g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ phyogs bzhi'i lcags mkhar bzhir/ ya ma me dak+ṣe las/ ya ma rā dza/ myos byed 'bar ba/ ār+ya me ru/ ral pa tshal dgu bzhi rang rang chung ma dang bcas pa/ yab rnams g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon zhags pa/ yum rnams g.yas spu gri g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol lcags mkhar bcu gnyis na/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni rnams las/ bdud 'joms/ dmar po/ kong rtse brag 'joms/ mig dmar/ mgo dgu/ lha mchog /a wa glang mgo/ tel pa/ ya wa ti/ stag mgo/ phya sangs/ chos rgyal rnams rang rang gi chung ma dang bcas pa/ yab rnams g.yas dbyug to g.yon zhags pa/ yum rnams g.yas spu gri g.yon thod khrag thogs pa/

de rnams kyi 'khor du gshin rje pho mo bdun brgya nyi shu/ sha za yi dwags 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur par bsam/ ya ma rā dza nṛ dzaḥ hūm̐ ya mān+ta kṛta tsak+ṣuḥpra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces spyan dbye/ ya mān tsakra gṛ ha pra we sha sha/ zhes snyan dbye/ nṛ yaṃ bh+rūṃ bruṃ/ zhes shangs bsal/ ha ha pra we sha khā hi/ zhes zhal dbye/ tri po pra we sha badz+ra aṃ ku sha laṃ/ zhes pas ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ muñja ba si la/ zhes pas langs par gyur par bsam/ rang rgyud pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ lag g.yon lcags kyu dang g.yas be con gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ na mo bud+dhā ya dharma saṃgha bh+yaḥ ta thā ga ta kro dha bi dza ya ag+nirdza li tā pra tsa shi ka pra ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces/ be con sa gzhi la bsnun pas sa gzhi shag gis gas ma thag bdag ya mā rir gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og lho phyogs gshin yul dme nag nas 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje pho mo 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis glog 'gyu ba ltar bkug par gyur par bsam/ ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ tri sna dza ma ri hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dang*/ spyan drang ba ni/ sha chen gyi gsur btang*/ bshug pa dang rkang gling rdza rnga'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ 'di nas lho yi phyogs dag na// ri rab chen po'i rmang dag na// dpag tshad brgyad khri phar 'das na// lcags kyi khang sgrom sgo med na// yid kyis rgyu ba'i sgo can na// mi ro rta ros gtams pa'i gnas// khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas// gnam lcags khro chu khol ma'i gnas// ro myags chen po'i gnas shed nas// yi dwags bdag po gshin rje'i gtso// nag po rak+sha glog phreng can// srid pa lto na 'chang zhing 'gal byed zhags pa 'debs// yum ni bdud kyi rgyal mo dug hrul can| |las kyi rlung dmar zhon nas stong gsum nad kyis 'gengs// be con 'khor lo bskor zhing 'gal byed rtsad nas gcod// thugs dam rjes su dran zhing dmar chen khrag la gshegs| |bdud po nag po bye ba gung ring dun ting kha la ya dgra bgegs kyi srog la bh+yo bh+yoḥ

zhes gtso bo yab yum dang*/ hūm̐ */ de yi phyi rim phyogs bzhi'i lcags mkhar nas// gshed kyi blon po gshin rje yab yum bzhi// ya ma rā dza srin mo sha za ma// myos byed 'bar ba srin mo stobs chen ma// ār+ya me ru srin mo seng ge ma// ral pa tshal dgu srin mo 'bar ma rnams| |bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i rdzu 'phrul can// dam tshig rjes su dran zhing dmar chen khrag la gshegs// zhes gshed chen bzhi dang*/ hūm̐ */ de yi phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis na| |las kyi gshin rje rdo rje bran gyi tshogs// bdud 'joms dmar po kong rtse brag 'joms dang*// mig dmar mgo dgu lha mchog dud kha dang*// a wa glang mgo tel pa ya wa ti// stag mgo nag po phya sangs chos rgyal rnams// gshin rje'i gzugs ston dbyug to zhags pa 'debs// skye 'gro dbang sdud srid gsum khram la 'debs// las kyi srin mo gshin rje'i chung ma rnams// srin mo nag mo srin mo 'phyang ma dang*// srin mo lag brgya srin mo sder mo dang*// srin mo zhags pa srin mo mig brgya pa// srin mo dmar mo srin mo 'brug sgrog ma// srin mo dbugs 'phrog srin mo nad gtong ma// srin mo khrag 'thung srin mo sbyin sreg ma// 'jig rten 'gro la nad kyi tshogs gtong zhing*// skye 'gro'i srog len sha khrag mdangs za ma// sna tshogs gzugs kyis gnod pa sna tshogs byed// dus kyi zhags pas dam nyams snying nas 'dren// dam tshig rjes su dran zhing dmar chen khrag la gshegs// ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ dza ma ri hūm̐ dzaḥ ā ra li hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas 'khor gyi gshin rje khram bdag bcu gnyis 'bod do// dza ma ri hūm̐ sa ma ya/ ya ma sma ra a ti tri shu sa ma ya āḥ bos pa'i 'chi bdag 'khor bcas bsgoms pa'i lha rnams la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ */

las kyi 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// sgrub pa po yi don bsgrub phyir// ya mān+ta ka'i bka' bzhin du// las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol// ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya/ zhes bzhugs su gsol lo// mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bstan la/ hūm̐ */ nga ni khro bo'i rgyal po ste// 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad kun// ma lus zil gyis gnon par byed// 'jig rten khams gsum kun tu gnod// ya ma rā dza sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes zil gyis mnan/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ hūm̐ */ 'jig rten las kyi rdzu 'phrul bas// ye shes rdzu 'phrul bdag la mnga'// 'jig rten gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// srid pa'i snying khrag nga la yod// nga ni bgegs chen 'dul ba yi// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul bdag sbyong bas// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ngas dbang bsdus// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas ngas bsdu'o// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ slar yang*/ ya ma me dak+ṣe/ yak+ṣe ta/ me ma ra ṇi/ dza ya ra ṇi/ yo na ru do sa dzaḥ zhes gzhi snying nyi shu pa brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig yan chad bzlas la dbang du bsdu'o// rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ hūm̐ */ sngon tshe ya mān+ta ka ni// khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' des// 'chi bdag gshin rje rab gzir tshe// dregs pa spangs te srog snying phul// bka' yi 'khor du dam tshig byin// las byed gshin rjer khyod dbang bskur// de tshe'i dam tshig dran par gyis// be wa sa ta sa ma ya// ma hā ye sa ma ya thā/ zhes dam la bzhag /be con gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ hūm̐ */ lag na rdo rje be con 'chang*// 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka yis// 'chi bdag nag po khyod 'khor bcas// mya ngan 'das pa'i sa ru bzhag /gal te dam las khyod 'das na// dam tshig 'dis ni khyod gsod do// ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa// ces dam bsgrags/

hūm̐ */ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'gal 'das sreg byed cing*// 'jam pa'i rdo rje rab khros pas// khyod kyi snying dang mgo 'gas byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob| |rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūm̐/ pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes mna' chu sbyin/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// sngon gyi dam tshig dran par gyis// rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di bzlas pas// mi phyed rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di// khyod kyi snying la gnas par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐// zhes pa rnams kyis dam la bzhag la/ 'chi bdag 'khor bcas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pas dam la gnas te bdag gis ci bcol las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par gyur par bsam/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ grub pa'i gshin rje 'dus pa'i tshogs| |phyugs chen khrag la zhabs bsil te// dmar chen khrag la sa ma ya// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di la rol// ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ be wa sa ta dza ma ri ma hā rak+ta pra tīts+tsha hoḥ hūm̐ */ 'chi bdag gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs// las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas// ma hā rak+ta'i ar+ghaṃ dang*// sha chen bdug pa'i spos mchog dang*// dbang po lnga yi me tog dang*// bdud rtsi gu gul dri chab dang*// tshil chen snang ba'i mar me dang*// 'chi med bdud rtsi sha chen spos// rdza rnga rkang gling rol mo'i sgra// dpa' bo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥka la ma ta ha na/ oṃ hrīḥti ku kha hi ti/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥka ra la bhan+dha ha/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ bi shwa ga taṃ/ oṃ dzi dzi/ oṃ hūm̐ kha ka kha ka/ hūm̐ */ phyugs chen sha dang rkang dang khrag /lha ba rus pa bdud rtsi 'bar// dbang po tshim byed 'dod yon lnga// mchod yon bdud rtsi ting 'dzin gyi// grub pa gshin rje'i tshogs rnams rol// ha hā/

hi hī/ khā hi khā hi// ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ/ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ/ ma hā a mṛ ta kha raṃ/ hūm̐ */ 'chi bdag nag po 'khor bcas la// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyis mchod// baṃ chen gsang ba'i rak+tas mchod// dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor mas mchod// tshim par bzhes la phrin las mdzod// ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza pañca a mṛ ta/ ma hā ru dhī ra/ ma hā ba l+yā di i maṃ khā hi/ zhes dang*/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas gtor ma byin brlabs nas/ rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba ling+ta i maṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ma ma sā dha ka s+ya sarba karma sid+dhi ku ru/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig gi gtor ma phul bas mnyes shing tshims par bsam mo// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na// dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na// 'byung ba bzhi yi 'og rol na// rgya mtsho'i gling gi bar shed na// 'chi bdag nyi zla'i 'od zer can// nag po 'char ka zhes kyang bya/ bye ba dgu khri zhes kyang bya// chos kyi rgyal po zhes kyang bya// a wa glang mgo zhes kyang bya// bde gshegs sprul pa'i ngo bo nyid// 'jam dpal nyid las ma g.yos te// gdul bya'i don du dmyal ba'i lus// mthing nag gzugs thung gsus po che// lhu gzugs thung la rab tu sbom// mig ni dmar la zlum po log /dri mi zhim la brda mi 'phrod/ rab tu gtum pa'i gzugs can zhig /srid pa gsum po lto na 'chang*// dge sdig gnyis kyi bya ra byed// gson gshin gnyis kyi zam kha bo// 'gro ba kun gyi dus mtha' ru// srog la dbang byed 'chi bdag byed// rig sngags 'khrul 'khor sku la gnas// dus ma yin par srog la 'bebs// de ni sprul pa'i 'khor lo yin// yum ni gtum mo dug hrul can// yab yum gnyis med sngags kyi bdag

/bde gshegs phyag mtshan 'khor lo dang*// gshed bzhi 'khor bcas phyag rgya ru// mtshon cha 'khor lo mang po thogs// gang la dmigs pa myur du gsod// khram bdag gshin rje bcu gnyis dang*// srin mo rang rang 'khor dang bcas// 'chi bdag tshogs la bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ hoḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po khyod kyi lto ba na/ srid pa gsum po yang yod pas na/ khyod kyis mi 'dul mi 'grub ci yang med kyi/ rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las che ge mo 'di da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod cig sa ma ya hoḥ zhes phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir 'khrul 'khor yod na/ las gshin gyi thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la ya yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ 'khor gyi thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ bdag ya mā ri'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas las gshin gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'khor bcas pa la phog pas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas/ bdag gis gang bsgo ba'i phrin las thams cad skad cig la sgrub cing*/ las gal che na rang ya mā rir gsal ba'i zhabs g.yas gnam lcags kyi phur bu lcags bsregs pa lta bu me 'bar bas las gshin gyi snying khar brdzis shing mnan/ gzir bas kho 'dar zhing brgyal ba la thug nas bdag gis bka' gang bstsal sgrub par khas blangs dam bcas zhes skabs 'dir 'jug pa yin no// las gshin gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ 'khor rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon la phog pas rang dbang med par las la bskul te phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub cing 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las kyang 'od zer phyogs thams cad du spros pas snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad las la bskul te/ phrin las thams cad da lta nyid du sgrub par gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ ya ma me dak+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces pa ci 'grub bzla/ mgo mjug tu oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'am/ ma sbyar gang rung byas kyang chog /oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'ang ci 'grub bzla'o// de rjes zhi rgyas dbang dang de'i dgug pa sogs kyi 'khrul 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs thun bzhi'am drug tu las gshin la gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ skabs gzhan du drag po ma yin pa'i gtor 'bul sogs bya ba ni/ gtor mar sman rak+ta bran/ dpal 'bar btsugs/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba ni/ sngar ltar ya ma bcu bdun pa'i mthar/ ma hā ba l+yā di dgra bo che ge mo'i sha khrag rus gsum/ rkang klad/ nang khrol/ dbang po/ don snying*/ phung khams/ skye mched dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs btags pa nyer gcig gam bdun gyis phul nas/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ 'di nas byang phyogs ri bo'i rmang*// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na// srog la dbang byed gshin rje ni// yab yum blon 'bangs chung ma dang*// bran dang bka' nyan pho nyar bcas| |sha za yi dwags 'khor bcas rnams// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi// gtor ma rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la// 'jam dpal ya man+ta ka yis// ji ltar bka' bsgos gnyer gtad bzhin// myur ba myur bar las mdzod cig /phrin las gnyan po da sgrubs shig /rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag gi// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// mos bzhis khams gsum dbang du bsdus// yid smon gang 'dod khug la shog /rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang*| |snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams// dbang du bsdus la rdul du rlogs// rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs te// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces dbul/

gsol mchod dus gtor sogs yin na gtor ma lho phyogs su dbul/ yang drag po'i 'khrul 'khor bsad bskrad dbye rmongs reng mnan sogs sgrub tshe thun drug gam bzhir bskul ba dang*/ phrin las drag po'i dus yin na gtor mar sha khrag bsnol zan sman raka bran/ dgug gzhug sogs kyi mthar/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs la sngags ya ma bcu bdun par/ ma hā ba l+yā di sogs btags pa nyer gcig gam bcu bdun gyis gtor ma phul la drag tu bskul ba ni/ tshil chen gyi spos btang*| rak+tas brlabs/ bshug pa dang rkang gling gi sgra dang bcas khros pa'i sems dang ya mān+ta ka'i nga rgyal gyis bskul ring ni/ hūm̐ */ 'di nas byang phyogs ri bo chen po'i rmang*// dpag tshad brgyad khri mar 'das na// thod pa lcags kyi mkhar nang na// mi ros gtams pa'i gdan steng na// ma mo kun gyi gtso rje bo// yi dwags kun gyi ded dpon pa// lcags mkhar bcu bdun mnga' bdag po// bdud po mi zan skye 'gro'i bdud// bye ba gung ring sus mi bzlog /me lce glog gi phreng bas brgyan// gcer bu sbrul dang thod pas brgyan// yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo 'di// zhags pa thob la khrid la shog /khram la thob la stong la skyus// be con rgyob la 'khor lo bskor// khyod kyi zas skal 'di yin gyi// sha rus khrag la longs spyod gyis// de yis thugs dam rgyud bskul ba| |gtum mo dug hrul gos gyon ma// bdud mo nag mo skye 'gro'i bdud// sna tshogs nad kyi mnga' bdag mo// sha khrag srog dbugs bdag mo khyod// grub pa'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs la// bdud rtsi byang chub sems dang dmar chen maṃ sa dang*// dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*// 'chi bdag gshin rje gdug pa pho mo khyod// dbus nas rnam shes rtsad gcod smyo 'bog thong*// dus kyi zhags pas drangs shing bsgral du gsol// nag po rak+sha dgra bo'i snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ

hūm̐ */ grub pa'i gnas nas dgra bo'i gshed ma bzhi// ya ma rā dza myos byed 'bar ba dang*// ār+ya me ru ral pa tshal dgu bzhi// srin mo sha za srin mo stobs chen dang*// srin mo seng ge srin mo 'bar ma bzhi// phyogs bzhi'i thod mkhar bzhi nas 'dir gshegs la// bdud rtsi byang chub sems dang dmar chen maṃ sa dang*// dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*// bstan pa 'jig pa'i 'gal byed dgra bo 'di// mgo 'khor yid 'khrug khrag tu skyug pa dang*// rnam shes gzir te myur du bsgral ba dang*// yan lag 'brum bu drag pos gzir ba dang*// lhog rgal pho log glang 'thab myur du thong*// dus kyi zhags pas srog dbugs phrol la shog /hūm̐ */ gshed chen yab yum srog las grub pa'i tshogs// 'jig rten phung byed gshin rje pho mo rnams// dus kyi zhags pa nad rnams sna tshogs bdag /gshin rje'i bdud 'joms gshin rje dmar po dang*// kong rtse brag 'joms ya ma rā dza'i sras// grub pa'i klong nas 'dir gshegs sa ma ya// bdud rtsi byang chub sems dang dmar chen maṃ sa dang*// dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*// bstan pa bshig pa'i 'gal byed dgra bo 'di// gzer nad tsha ba'i nad dang khrag skyug gis// myur du gzir te dus kyi zhags pas drongs// gshin rje mig dmar lcog pa mgo dgu dang*// lha mchog dud kha myos byed 'bar ba'i sras// grub pa'i klong nas 'dir gshegs sa ma ya// bdud rtsi byang chub sems dang dmar chen maṃ sa dang*// dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*// bstan pa 'jig pa'i 'gal byed dgra bo 'di// cho 'phrul 'brum nag mkhris pa k+ṣa ya yis| |myur du gzir te dus kyi zhags pas drongs// gshin rje'i a wa glang mgo ya ba ti// gshin rje tel pa ma ru rtse yi sras// phol mig glo gzer skya rbab dang*| |shu ba g.yan pa 'gyel nad dag gis ni// myur du gzir te dus kyi zhags pas drongs// gshin rje stag mgo nag po phya sangs dang*// chos kyi rgyal po ral pa tshal dgu'i
